text_block_list.text:
"It happened while I was gathering data
with Biwa Hayahide for the next race—"
(Crack)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun!?

—As I held my aching arm,
Biwa Hayahide looked at me with concern.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How bad is the pain?
Where does it hurt? Is it swollen?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's not fine!
What if it's something serious?! We're going to the nurse's office right this second!!
And so, I ended up getting dragged all the way to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: It's just tendinitis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
You can't do that. You must rest your hands and arms properly.
At worst, this condition could require surgery.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: "Don't just use compresses; make sure to properly rest the affected area. There doesn't seem to be swelling... so it should be mild."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Please take a rest for a while, and if
the pain remains severe, be sure
to consult a medical institution again.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, sir...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a worrywart of an Umamusume.
Though looking at the Trainer, they seemed to know it was only mild from the start.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"Bringing them along out of worry, nonetheless.
You must care very deeply
for your Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Let's see how it goes for 2 or 3 days, and if the symptoms lighten up,
we'll head to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, I will nurse you back to health thoroughly.
First is rest. If you wish to think about my training,
at least wait until a week from now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
First, apply for leave. Work stops here.
If there are urgent tasks that need immediate attention,
I'll consult with Tazuna-san as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If swelling, pain, or fever returns while you are resting,
please contact me immediately.
As for the day of the hot springs trip—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Do you, the one who made me worry, actually have an objection?
Biwa Hayahide has that look of utter seriousness in her eyes...!
And on the day of the hot spring recuperation...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
After researching various hot springs, this water's
mineral profile proved most effective for your condition.
It's highly recommended as a recuperation facility, too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry. By coincidence, it is the exact place from the 'Hot Springs Voucher' I won in the shopping district.
Both of us can use it for free.

I definitely remember winning a
Hot Spring Trip Voucher before...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us head inside at once.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a nice bath. How about you?
choice_data_list: That really worked out the stiffness!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see, it seems your poor circulation has improved.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is the meal. I have already ordered
a course centered around hot pot. The nutrients include vitamins B1,
B2, beta-carotene, allicin, and more—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...? Is there something you can't eat?
You informed me of your allergies beforehand, but...
choice_data_list: Why don't we relax just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Slowly...?
choice_data_list: You should take a break too, while you have the chance.
Since you have the chance, I want you to rest too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"You're always worrying about me like that.
Putting me first before yourself."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Then please, let me worry about you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...
choice_data_list: Have you calmed down a bit?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Long ago. Because I'm with you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's about time they brought the food.
Let's relax and enjoy the meal.

And so, I enjoyed a nutritious dinner
together with Biwa Hayahide.

In that moment, I felt an irreplaceable bond
forming between Biwa Hayahide and myself...
